semantic_fragments.content: Individual measurement error formula: δ = |tj - tBB|, where tj is the displayed or calculated value of unadjusted temperature, tBB is the true temperature of the blackbody, j is the sequential number of a reading, and || signifies taking an absolute value. The largest δj is a measure of the laboratory error of a system. At blackbody setting temperature of 37°C and power supply voltage of 2.5V, the measured readings were 36.90, 36.7, 36.8, 36.9, 36.8°C with an average of 36.8°C and maximum error δ = 0.1°C.
